name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-outlook
description: Read, search, draft, send and organize Microsoft Outlook mail via Microsoft Graph, safe by default.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Entra (Azure AD) app (client) id. For browser sign-in, register a public client with redirect URI http://localhost.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Directory tenant: a tenant id, or common | organizations | consumers (default common).

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App secret for app-only (client-credentials) auth. Omit to use interactive browser sign-in.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A pre-obtained Microsoft Graph bearer token (alternative to browser or app-only auth).

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_USER
environmentVariables.description: Target mailbox (user id or UPN) for app-only auth. Omit to use the signed-in user's mailbox (/me).

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set true to permit sending mail (send/reply/forward). Off by default.
